notes.title: Patch 4 - Difficutly turning and Cloudsaves
notes.content:
Thank you so much for all the feedback and bugreports, this time I adressed some more problematic stuffs, as well as doing some compatibility fixes with old processors, got in touch with a Unity Engineer and we solved this together. Game was advertized to run on a potato, so adjustments were made.

If youre playing the game on multiple devices, I reccomend opening the game on the device you want to keep your saves from first and play on the files you wish to keep.

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Interrupted special moves no longer cost mana.
[*] Added a lot more checkpoints in the game to reduce runback times.
[*] Filly will now stubbornly cling to life if punted into some gamer fuel.
[*] Goony should now be a bit more talkative.
[*] All four playable characters now have their own portraits.
[*] Save files are now located in appdata/locallow/bitgames/anonfilly/saves and should be syncronized by the steam cloud.
[*] Added an option in the meny to swap to/from windowed mode.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Compatibility fix for older CPUs
[*] Display correct outfit on the savefile
[*] Fixed some menu bugs with controllers
[*] Can't peform special moves when downed
[*] Fixed audio bug in the water escape section
[*] Defeating Goony should prevent her from respawning even if you double KO
[*] Fixed Various Layering issues
[*] Resolution problems with Arena Fights
[*] Softlock in the waterslide section fight should no longer be a thing
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 3
notes.content: Fixed the speedrun clock to show real seconds instead of filly seconds.

notes.title: Patch 2
notes.content:
Still doing minor fixes of stuffs that break the game, but we got some QOL stuffs in here.
[list]
[*] Remixed the Audio for the Mines to be less ear grating
[*] Partial saving when going through areas and picking up upgrades.
[*] Made some Cosmetic improvement on the Final Boss
[*] You can no longer escape the red fish duel in the City.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed a few critical bugs

[list]
[*] The Extras Menu should work with a controller now
[*] The lift after the Red Lizzard properly reset on hard and brutal difficulty
[*] Stopped the filly from escaping the giant enemy crab fight.
[*] Goony now respects the Music Settings.
[*] Drop Crabs should be significantly less loud.
[*] Inventory should not double up with pausing the game anymore.
[/list]
There is a lot more known bugs and gameplay issues that will be fixed in a larger patch in the future, this patch is only to adress critical bugs. But if you find any problems with the game, report them in the bugs/feedback forums so I can read and fix them.
